rule: E2+ required to be a MODEL_SPEC_CANDIDATE component; E0/E1 -> PARK

components.mechanism: Point-in-time market state vector built ONLY from information available at t (as-of join, no future).
components.required_data: bid, ask, mid, spread, spread percentile, rolling volatility, quote arrival, tick-rule proxy
components.formula: state(t) = [spread_bp, spread_pctile_n, rv_n, quote_rate, flow_proxy_n, displacement_1s, displacement_5s]
components.assumption: all terms computed with as-of (backward) joins; anything needing a future window is FORBIDDEN here
components.failure_mode: look-ahead via a centred/lagged window computed with a forward shift

components.mechanism: Directional signal that maps the state to an expected signed move. MUST NOT use post-fill quantities.
components.required_data: state vector only (no OFI/microprice on FXTM -> substitute L1 return/reversal terms)
components.formula: signal(t) = g(state(t)) ; on FXTM g may not use true OFI, microprice, queue or trade flow
components.assumption: the strongest published L1 signals rely on OFI/microprice; on FXTM those are DATA_GAP, so the signal is degraded
components.failure_mode: reusing a post-fill markout as a feature (leakage); renaming a proxy to the real quantity

components.mechanism: Expected GROSS markout per horizon, measured mid-to-mid, never mixed with cost.
components.formula: gross_edge(t,h) = E[ d * (mid(t+h) - mid(t)) ] ; signed midpoint movement, three-way (favourable/unchanged/adverse)
components.assumption: mid-based labels avoid bid-ask bounce inflation; forward windows must be segment-guarded
components.failure_mode: mid label used as if it were an executable price (ignores the spread you must cross)

components.source_repo: DaniyalMlk/slippage (E5 Perold, order-vs-executed basis); aryansiwach/execution-market-microstructure (E4 opportunity on unfilled); gelatotrade (E3); AshJha0 (E4-eng)
components.mechanism: Explicit additive cost decomposition with declared signs; includes the opportunity term on the UNFILLED fraction.
components.formula: IS_total = Spread + Impact + Fee + Opportunity ; Opportunity = max(0, adverse post-window drift) * UNFILLED fraction  || aryansiwach: opp = side*(final_mid-arrival_mid)/arrival_mid*1e4 * unfilled/target ; is_bps = (filled/target)*exec_cost + opp
components.assumption: each term separately visible; positive = cost; unknown = DATA_GAP never 0; the DELAY term has two conventions (order-basis charges all target shares, executed-basis charges only traded shares) and both must be declared
components.failure_mode: silently booking unfilled size at the arrival price (opportunity cost = 0); netting costs invisibly

components.mechanism: Post-fill adverse drift measured as a three-way classification; diagnostic only, never an entry feature.
components.formula: AS_h = entry_exec_price - mid(t+h) for LONG ; mid(t+h) - entry_exec_price for SHORT ; AS>0 = adverse
components.assumption: measured, never injected; at FXTM only L1 markout is available (queue-based AS is DATA_GAP)
components.failure_mode: circularity (injecting the adverse move then measuring it); using realised AS inside the entry decision

components.source_repo: SpencerOzgur (E3: front-of-queue vs back-of-queue run AND reported separately); aryansiwach (E4 simulate_limit: queue_ahead/cancel_on_through/deadline_ns + residual sweep); tfrmma (E3)
components.mechanism: Execution model: taker crosses the spread at t+latency; exit cost is a SECOND spread crossing.
components.required_data: bid, ask, measured latency (FXTM RTT ~279 ms)
components.formula: fill_price = ask(t+L) BUY / bid(t+L) SELL ; exit adds a SECOND spread + commission. Maker fills must be reported as a front/back QUEUE PAIR (theoretical vs executable), never as a single number.
components.assumption: fill is ASSUMED for market orders (no fill model); passive fill is DATA_GAP on FXTM
components.failure_mode: assuming mid fills; counting the spread once instead of twice

components.source_repo: siddhantsingh-1 (cost hurdle, E4); n30dyn4m1c/gold-pro-scalper (cost-multiple gate, E1 corroboration)
components.mechanism: Compare expected edge against the full cost BEFORE trading; abstain when the inequality fails.
components.required_data: expected gross edge, full cost, uncertainty band
components.formula: TAKE iff E[net_edge] - uncertainty_margin > 0 ; cost-multiple variant: edge_fuel >= k1 * RT_cost and target >= k2 * RT_cost
components.assumption: the gate is a comparison, not a fitted classifier; k1/k2 are NOT set here
components.failure_mode: lowering the gate to increase fill rate (destroys the economics)

components.source_repo: r33bt (E1) + quantskills (E2) for the exponential fit; zj092912 (E3, REAL data) for the exit-cost annihilation; AshJha0 (E4-eng) price-shift invariance; KlishevDA (markout curves)
components.mechanism: Exit when the expected REMAINING edge falls below the expected exit cost; four failure classes kept separate.
components.required_data: current state, position, elapsed time, cost of a second crossing
components.formula: E(t) = E0 * exp(-lambda*t), t_half = ln2/lambda, lambda by log-linear OLS on ln E vs h  ||  EXIT iff E[remaining_edge] - exit_cost < 0, exit_cost = one more spread + commission
components.assumption: NO repo derives E(t) from microstructural primitives; the exponential form is a FIT, not a law. zj092912 shows the exit spread can annihilate the entire mid edge (mark-to-mid Sharpe 1.08 -> realised -$24.9M), so lambda is irrelevant if exit_cost >= residual edge at every horizon.
components.failure_mode: fixed TP/SL ignoring decay; exiting on realised PnL instead of expected remaining edge; fitting the decay on the same trades it times

components.source_repo: AMIRMAHMOUDINIA (E5: pre-registered gates, locked test, HAC, BH-FDR, block bootstrap); snowkings; himagna16; Trumplus
components.mechanism: Every edge estimate carries edge/execution/data uncertainty; overlapping events must not be treated as independent.
components.formula: report edge_uncertainty (CI), execution_uncertainty (fill/cost band), data_uncertainty (DATA_GAP list); effective_N = n/max(1,rho); cost sensitivity across 0..12 bps as in AMIRMAHMOUDINIA
components.assumption: no CI is implied from the raw event count when events cluster; unobservable outcomes are excluded, never 0
components.failure_mode: quoting a t-stat from overlapping events; reporting a mean without the median/tail

components.mechanism: Inventory-aware sizing/reservation price. Included for completeness; NOT usable without a fill model.
components.formula: reservation price r = s - q*gamma*sigma^2*tau ; optimal spread delta = gamma*sigma^2*tau + (2/gamma)*ln(1+gamma/k)
components.assumption: the A-S form assumes continuous quoting and a calibrated intensity k; FXTM has neither
components.failure_mode: importing A-S quoting without an intensity calibration; treating inventory skew as edge
